task_title: Uniform CF_* harness variable contract across every installer, the node bus worker, and the conformance battery
task_criteria: Every script under scripts/harness accepts the specs/HARNESS-MATRIX.md section 5 CF_* set, documents it in --help, and refuses a credential passed as a VALUE with a named failure while accepting only a path; node-bus-worker.py passes the set from the directive to the harness and records which values it passed; and the conformance battery carries a vars leg that is green for every harness row and red when one declared variable is dropped.
